title: Better Plains Biome
description: Makes plains browner and more realistic, just like in real life.
body:
# Better Plains Biome

A resource pack that transforms plains biomes with realistic brown grass, giving them that authentic Great Plains grassland appearance.

---

## What It Does

This resource pack changes grass in plains biomes from bright green to natural brown/tan colors using Minecraft's colormap system. The brown tones vary based on temperature and rainfall, creating realistic dry grassland aesthetics across different plains variants.
---
![A meadow.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/42376f64da463762ac435626b9d2d778d1bfb6ec.png)
---

## Why This Pack?

Vanilla Minecraft plains have unrealistically bright green grass that looks more like a golf course than actual prairies or grasslands. Real plains biomes - like the American Great Plains, African savannas, or Eurasian steppes - feature golden, tan, and brown grasses, especially during dry seasons.

This pack brings that realism to Minecraft, making plains biomes look like the vast, rolling grasslands they're meant to represent. The earthy brown tones create a more grounded, natural aesthetic that evokes the windswept plains of Norse landscapes and ancient grasslands. Your world will feel more authentic and lived-in, with that rugged, frontier atmosphere perfect for viking settlements, pastoral builds, or simply enjoying a more realistic Minecraft experience.

---

## Compatibility

### Requirements
- **Minecraft Version:** 1.21.1 (works with 1.21.x)
- **No mods required** - Works in vanilla Minecraft

### Works With
- Vanilla Minecraft
- Optifine
- Fabric/Forge
- Most shaders
- Other resource packs (if they don't modify grass colormaps)
- Multiplayer servers (client-side only)

### May Conflict With
- Resource packs that change `grass.png` or `foliage.png` colormaps
- Some biome mods that override vanilla colormap behavior

**Load Order:** Place this pack above other packs to ensure brown grass displays properly.

---

Perfect for survival worlds, prairie builds, Norse-themed settlements, and anyone who wants more realistic plains biomes. Simple, lightweight, and instantly transforms your grasslands into authentic, earthy terrain.

**Enjoy more authentic plains!**
